resources.string: Children and grandchildren send photos and notes to this TV with a link, no account needed
On: OK shows the QR code to share again

Scan the code with your phone and send the link to the family (WhatsApp, email). Whoever has the link can send photos and notes: they show up on the screen and on the screensaver. Nothing goes through our servers.
This uses access from outside the home (Tailscale), which is not set up on this TV yet. Set it up in Settings › Remote access, then come back here.
The old link stops working right away
